search.markdown:
Dear Celeste,

~~It's difficult to find the words~~

~~I've wanted to tell you~~

~~How do I say~~

Sleep has not come easy to me these past two years.

~~I wish~~

~~I regret the events that occurred~~

I miss you

---

Achievement and rule-following is the only life I've ever known. I thought it was the epitome of character. But then our home fell from the sky and I wonder what it was all for. My north star turned out to be a demonic creature of death.

- The Silver City screeched and sheared against the failing chains of Marduun's Stratos Tether.
- Celeste was lost in a something like a memory: having a picnic with her father Exander.
	- Would you still love me if I did something *yikes* bad? - Celeste
	- "A weed is only a weed because _we_ labeled it so." - Exander
- Spark cast Divine Intervention, shouting about weak-willed gods while headbutting Timar.
	- This forced Timar's eyes open.
- Skrimhawk slipped outside of time. Chronos introduced themself, offering their help.
	- Each lock on the Arcane Multilock clicked open, and Chronos's voice emanated from the Chronogual Orb
- Chronos asked if Skrimhawk would be willing to sacrifice himself to walk against the flow of time, since Timar needed more time to save the city from impact.
- Skrimhawk pulled the party and Timar back in time by a few moments.
- Timar burst through the mural above The Sanctum of the Lambs and caught the city, holding it in place.
- The party was approached by Punar Tillam, one of a few uninjured government officials attempting to bring some order to the aftermath.
	- He was from commerce. Basically an accountant.
	- The party did not trust him and restrained him, attempting to cast Banishment on him.
- Professor Marduun peered down through the shattered mural, requesting the party meet him at the surface
	- His staff's candles did not burn, a sight Celeste and HAL had never seen before
- The surface was a cold aftershock: many buildings in ruin, many bodies lying among the rubble
- HAL healed as many as he was able to
- Marduun asked the party to stay under the city's watch as the party was under suspicion.
	- He explained Castiel Ralora was found in a bunker built for such an occasion, and he was detained.
- While under "house arrest," Spark asked Kiktal to hit him. He had a breakthrough in his attempts to solidify magical flame.
- There was no trial brought against the party, but Councilwoman Veldrin Illiir heard the party's account of things
	- She thanked them. She gave Celeste an item (Spellbook Jailbreak) from her personal collection.
- Celeste's reunion with her parents, Maeve and Exander, was strained.
	- Celeste asked if the party could stay with them in their house for a short while.
- Exander revealed that he did not send HAL to find Celeste.
- Maeve asked the party to come to the Efthalia household for tea.
	- Celeste showed Skrimhawk and Spark her old room, her old clothes.
	- Skrimhawk noticed Celeste stuff a seemingly unimportant trophy into her bag.
	- Spark caught Flicker stealing, and they had a conversation about excess.
	- Spark talked about how he misses the old De Drakengardt, where gardeners used to walk among mortals, and the roads were filled with travelers you didn't have to avoid.
	- HAL went back to his old "room," a closet with unattached piping. He gathered some crayon drawings. Kiktal had a short, uncomfortable conversation about caring for people.
- One of Flicker's fireflies dissolved as Celeste heard "some things must be broken before they can be fixed." A spell wrought tattoo appeared on her of a little star.
